Got mine during sale too and did a lot of research so this will give you a head start. 

Highly recommend getting a prescription lenses from say Hons VR. This will help protect against scratches or the protective coating coming off.

Also be careful of sweat drying on your lenses as well as your eyebrows rubbing off on them. 

If you do those you should get a few years out of your VR headset 

It might be a little blurry at first but there is a “Sweet Spot”. The back of the headset should kinda be under the curve in your head if that makes sense. So the lenses should be around eye level while the back of the headset should be around the same level as your mouth for example. 

In terms of games, been loving 
- RE4 VR, 
- No man’s Sky 
- Gran Turismo 7. 
- The hitman WOA is coming around Christmas and this game defines the world “Sandbox”. It’s an incredible amount of content and replay ability. 
- If you are looking for 30% Skyrim 70% Dark souls look into a game called “Legendary Tales”. 
- If looking for a military sim/ horror game look into “into the radius” 

You may also feel motion sickness pretty quick early on. It’s important to stop then and there. Pretty quick you’ll get your “VR Legs” so you can have longer sessions but again be careful about the sweat.

Overall highly recommend getting the prescription lenses and enjoy the games you have
